name: Commit guard
summary: Block commits containing high-confidence secrets, sensitive files, or unsafe bypasses.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that inspects Git's staged blobs before commit and fails closed when staged content cannot be verified.
refuses: It does not rewrite staged files, mutate the Git index, or rotate credentials.
It does not transmit repository content or contact an external scanning service.
It does not claim to replace a full secret scanner or repository test suite.
It does not expose a project-writable allowlist, rule suppression, or environment bypass.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate structured runtime input and deterministically allow or block the guarded operation.
